# Page

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

### `PageBackground`

```csharp
IElement PageBackground { get; set; }
```

Full-page background element for this page only (drawn behind all content, ignoring margins). When set, the pipeline renders this element instead of calling `PageBackground` for this page (and any continuation pages its content overflows onto). Useful for per-page letterhead, cover images, or section dividers. Leave `null` to fall back to the document-level `PageBackground` template.

### `PageColor`

```csharp
Color? PageColor { get; set; }
```

Background colour for this page only. When set, the render pipeline fills the entire page (ignoring margins) with this colour behind everything else, overriding `PageColor` for this page. When `null`, the document-level `PageColor` (if any) is used. Leave both `null` for a transparent (viewer-default) background.

### `PageForeground`

```csharp
IElement PageForeground { get; set; }
```

Full-page foreground element for this page only (drawn on top of all content, ignoring margins). When set, the pipeline renders this element instead of calling `PageForeground` for this page (and any continuation pages). Useful for per-page "DRAFT"/"CONFIDENTIAL" overlays. Leave `null` to fall back to the document-level `PageForeground` template.
